sources: Built from 71 searches across both leagues (one direct pass, three delegated research passes with page reads) · NFL.com Week 8 injury report · PFT · PFF · Bleacher Report · Yahoo · NBC Sports · atozsports · Fantasy Footballers · Falcons.com · VAVEL · ABC7 · 4for4 · Yardbarker · Statchasers · VegasInsider

tonight.headline: 44.1 banked Thursday; Pickens and Rice still wait on Friday's report
body: Bad news first: George Pickens was limited again on Thursday with the shoulder and the hamstring, and Rashee Rice limited again with the hamstring and knee; neither has a Friday designation yet. Both are on the bench, so neither touches the lineup — but neither is a safe cover now.

Thursday went to plan: Josh Jacobs 23.2 (two touchdowns) and Matthew Golden 20.9 (7 catches, 79 yards, a touchdown) at Carolina, 27-19 (PFT 29 Oct). ESPN projects 140.4 to 121.1, 60%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Nothing to do before Sunday.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: 44.1 to 0.0 with seven starters to play; Metcalf Gala have their whole lineup left. ESPN's 60% already counts Thursday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Sunday inactive among Daniels, Taylor, Wilson, Tuten or Loveland — none is on Thursday's reports. If Garrett Wilson were ruled out, Pickens (if active) or Gordon would take the slot; that is a contingency only if a designation appears.

starting.name: Jonathan Taylor
starting.detail: IND · @ JAX · SUN 12:00 · Daniel Jones · trade deadline 10 Nov

report.availability: ACTIVE — not on the Colts' report

report.summary: ROLE_DOWN answered: McGowan's share has grown three straight weeks (34% of snaps in Week 7, FantasyLife) while Taylor still leads with about 20 carries a game and a league-high 8 rushing TDs. Analysts read McGowan's work as the Colts evaluating him before a possible Taylor trade — the 2-5 Colts dealt Nelson and Buckner on 27 Oct; Taylor says he 'hasn't heard anything' (NBC 29 Oct). Jacksonville 1st against backs (Statchasers, carried) — priced.
report.role: 18 carries, 3 targets in Week 7; 62% of the backfield
report.competition: Seth McGowan 30.5% of snaps and a third of the rushes in Week 7, his work arriving earlier in games (4for4/PFF 27 Oct); a possible top-20 back if Taylor is traded before 10 Nov (CBS 27 Oct)
